title: Tired of the blind hate whenever you mention AI in game dev. At the end of the day it still comes down to the person behind the project
author: WideWealth7349
selftext:
Just needed to vent here because I know you guys actually get it :)  I shared a clip of the game I've been working on for the past 4 weeks using Claude to help with the code. All I wanted was some constructive feedback to improve and immediately got hit with the classic "0 players because it's vibecoded" comment. Zero actual feedback on the game just instant hate.  
Honestly this automatic reaction online is so exhausting. Yeah low effort AI slop exists we all know that. And before anyone brings up the usual spaghetti code arguments obviously you can't just prompt make me a game and hit publish. You still have to understand architecture, fix bugs, balance everything and actually connect all the systems so the game works.

Whether a game has soul and feels coherent still depends 100% on the human behind the screen. It's about how much effort you put in and how you breathe life into the world so it doesn't feel like generic disconnected garbage! 

Times are changing. Huge companies are literally building their entire tooling around AI right now. In my opinion being a good system integrator who holds the vision, brings different tools together and actually ships a playable game is becoming way more valuable than manually typing every line of boilerplate code.  
Could it be that you're just totally frustrated? Honestly it would probably frustrate me too if I spent years programming and suddenly something shows up that can do a lot of that work faster or even better. I don't know if there are other reasons behind it so if there are normal people here who can actually explain to me calmly what their exact issue with it is that would already be a huge start.  
There are already plenty of successful games out there using AI and honestly normal players do not care how a game was made as long as it's fun and runs well. Nobody cares how many hours you suffered writing code from scratch.

Feel free to hate on me all you want, that's still my opinion :)
